videos.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
videos.overview: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. videos.title: Sid's Rainy Day Play Date
videos.overview: Sid isn't too happy and wonders if the rain knew he wanted to play outside? At school, Sid and his friends discover that rain actually comes from rain clouds! They also learn that rain is really important because it helps living things grow.

videos.title: Special Sunny Dad Day
videos.overview: At school, Sid and his friends discover that sunblock is a great way to protect your skin from the sun. And they also learn about the amazing ways the sun helps the Earth.

videos.title: Tarzan and Jane
videos.overview: Tarzan, rescued by Kala and given supernatural powers, defends the jungle from threats. Discovered by his grandfather's expedition, he meets Jane and returns to London. There, they uncover a plot to steal exotic animals, leading Tarzan and Jane to thwart the villains and save the animals.

videos.title: Blippi's Fun-Filled Learning Expeditions
videos.overview: Join Blippi and Meekah for a fun-filled day of learning and adventure across exciting locations like theme parks and children's museums. They explore the world around them, from riding on rails and in vehicles to discovering new things about animals, nature, and more. This high-energy adventure is packed with activities that encourage curiosity and play.

videos.title: The Berry Best Vacation
videos.overview: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top “Entertainment Tonight”-style show host/producer from Episode 206. videos.title: The Berry Long Winter
videos.overview: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City—a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. videos.title: Contact
videos.overview: Yusaku Fuiki, has become a celebrity in the aftermath of battling Hanoi. He continues to investigate the mysterious program he dubs "Ai." Meanwhile, SOL Technologies begins to look deeper into the identity of Playmaker.

videos.title: Pain and Gain
videos.overview: Go Onizuka, a popular duelist on Link VRAINS, accepts an offer from SOL to duel Playmaker. He wants to prove himself and he sees Playmaker as a powerful opponent. He lures Yusaku into a trap and a Speed Duel begins.

videos.title: Blippi and Meekah's Helpful Friends and Playful Adventures
videos.overview: Join Blippi and Meekah as they meet amazing community helpers during special trips to exciting places. They then dive into imaginative worlds for fun-filled activities, including foam parties and energetic games. Get ready for a collection of adventures packed with dancing, play, and learning essential concepts like colors.

videos.title: The Big Freeze
videos.overview: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors—the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. “We don't know when the next mail will get through!” It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting! She gets a brainstorm. videos.overview: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show.
